title: HTTP server
description: Built-in web server serving the UI and the REST API.

keys.name: port
keys.title: TCP port
keys.description: Port the HTTP server listens on.

keys.name: api_key
keys.title: API key
keys.description: Shared secret for the web UI and the REST API, sent as Authorization: Bearer or exchanged for a login cookie. Empty = no authentication, the API is open to anyone on the network. 8–64 characters; the Config page can generate one. Changing it logs every browser out.

keys.name: session_ttl_s
keys.title: Login session lifetime
keys.description: How long a browser login (the espos_sid cookie) stays valid. Sessions live in RAM; a reboot ends them all.
